definition: Mathlib Quiver.WeaklyConnectedComponent is the quotient by finite paths in the symmetrified quiver, so edges may be used forward or backward. In oneWay, accessibility is Bool order false ≤ true, including both loops; all worlds share a weak class, while false and true have distinct strong classes.
note: This is a two-world mathematical control. A reversed edge is permitted only in the weak connectivity query; it does not become an accessibility edge.
